items.title: request-filtering-agent before 3.2.2 SSRF Filter Bypass via IPv4-Compatible IPv6 Addresses
items.summary: request-filtering-agent before 3.2.2 contains a server-side request forgery filter bypass because address validation in src/request-filtering-agent.ts treats IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses in the ::/96 range as public unicast. Attackers controlling a fetched URL can use addresses like ::7f00:1 or ::a9fe:a9fe to reach loopback or link-local services, including cloud metadata endpoints.

items.title: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 Resource Exhaustion via Orphaned SM Contexts
items.summary: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in HandlePDUSessionSMContextLocalRelease that orphans SM contexts and UE IP addresses when PFCP session deletion fails. Attackers can send repeated PDU session establishment requests reusing an existing SUPI and PDU Session ID during PFCP deletion failures to exhaust the DNN's UE IP pool.

items.title: targets R package before 1.12.1 Code Execution via Custom Storage Metadata
items.summary: The targets R package before 1.12.1 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run arbitrary R code by planting format functions in the data store metadata file. Attackers can supply a crafted targets data store whose custom format or CAS repository functions are passed to eval(parse()), executing code when victims call tar read(), tar load() or tar workspace().

items.title: tianshiyeben wgcloud minTask Endpoint AgentController.java allocation of resources
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in tianshiyeben wgcloud up to 4.0.1. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file AgentController.java of the component minTask Endpoint. Executing a manipulation can lead to allocation of resources. The attack can be executed remotely.

items.title: Query ID predictable from a short sequence of observations
items.summary: Net::DNS uses a 16-bit query ID to match responses to the corresponding requests. In versions up to and including 1.57, the ID is obtained from Perl's built-in rand() function. An attacker that can observe the sequence of query IDs is able to expose the internal state of the PNRG and hence predict query IDs before they are transmitted. The victim Net::DNS instance is then exposed to forged responses injected by the…

items.title: Joomla Extension - joomlatools.com - Local file read through remote document links in DOCman extension < 6.2.2
items.summary: Joomla Extension - joomlatools.com - Local file read through remote document links in DOCman extension < 6.2.2 - Remote document links accepted the file:// scheme, allowing users with permission to create or edit documents to download arbitrary local files from the server, such as the Joomla configuration file.

items.title: PowerJob CachingRequestBodyFilter CachingRequestBodyFilter.java CustomHttpServletRequestWrapper denial of service
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in PowerJob up to 5.1.7. This affects the function CustomHttpServletRequestWrapper of the file powerjob-server/powerjob-server-starter/src/main/java/tech/powerjob/server/config/CachingRequestBodyFilter.java of the component CachingRequestBodyFilter. Executing a manipulation can lead to denial of service. It is possible to launch the attack remotely.

items.title: SiYuan before 3.8.5 Stored XSS via Heading Style Attribute
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.5 fails to escape heading style attributes when rendering outline and bookmark dock HTML, allowing stored cross-site scripting. Attackers can supply crafted notebooks or call administrative endpoints to inject malicious style values that execute in the Electron renderer with full system access.

items.title: SiYuan before 3.8.5 Stored XSS via notebook names
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.5 renders notebook names as raw HTML in the Daily Note picker dialog without escaping, allowing stored cross-site scripting in the Electron renderer. Attackers can create notebooks with HTML payloads in names that execute JavaScript with Node.js access when the picker opens, enabling operating system command execution.

items.title: SiYuan before 3.8.5 Access Control Bypass via Dynamic Icon Endpoint
items.summary: SiYuan versions before 3.8.5 fail to enforce publish access control in the getDynamicIcon endpoint, allowing read-only token holders to access document metadata. Attackers can call the endpoint with type=8 and crafted content to read block titles, names, aliases, and hierarchical paths of restricted documents via template injection.

items.title: PrestaShop psgdpr before 1.4.4 GDPR Log Forgery
items.summary: PrestaShop psgdpr versions before 1.4.4 fail to validate that GDPR consent log entries are attributed to the authenticated customer. Authenticated attackers can submit arbitrary customer identifiers to create forged consent records for other customers, corrupting audit logs.
